title: Food Servers, Nonrestaurant
description: Serve food to individuals outside of a restaurant environment, such as in hotel rooms, hospital rooms, residential care facilities, or cars.

tasks.text: Place food servings on plates or trays according to orders or instructions.
Load trays with accessories, such as eating utensils, napkins, or condiments.
Stock service stations with items, such as ice, napkins, or straws.
Prepare food items, such as sandwiches, salads, soups, or beverages.
Clean or sterilize dishes, kitchen utensils, equipment, or facilities.
Remove trays and stack dishes for return to kitchen after meals are finished.
Carry food, silverware, or linen on trays or use carts to carry trays.
Monitor food distribution, ensuring that meals are delivered to the correct recipients and that guidelines, such as those for special diets, are followed.
Monitor food preparation or serving techniques to ensure that proper procedures are followed.
Examine trays to ensure that they contain required items.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Take food orders and relay orders to kitchens or serving counters so they can be filled.
Total checks, present them to customers, and accept payment for services.
Record amounts and types of special food items served to customers.
Determine where patients or patrons would like to eat their meals and help them get situated.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
